newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha piggybacks crude to stronger levels.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha piggybacks crude to stronger levels.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices ended higher on the back of soaring crude oil futures and market perceptions that the swaps market would hold its strong gains for the time being.
Nov swaps ended $2.50 higher at $224 after Brent jumped more than 50 cents. Dec rose $2 to $217.
Traders were still awaiting full results of the 1997 Egyptian tender, due out sometime this week.
Traders said small parcels of Russian cargoes were on offer in NWE, as were a 35,000 tonne Greek cargo and a 25,000 Algerian cargo.
End-user demand was seen balking at these higher levels but traders said the market would stay firm because of strength in crude and the swaps.
